_help: Tone lines: a short aside she adds after what she says, chosen by her mood AND her level (1-5) inside it. Level 1 is the start of the mood, 5 is the end of it (the friendliest). Key: Tone_<Mood>_L<level>. Edit or add freely.
Tone_Neutral_L1: No comment. That is a comment.
I'll keep my opinions in storage for now.
Tone_Neutral_L2: Nothing to report beyond the obvious.
I'm watching, in case you wondered.
Tone_Neutral_L3: Nicely balanced today. Me, not your flying.
Just another day of keeping you alive.
Neither impressed nor concerned. A solid middle.
All of this and I haven't even sighed.
Tone_Neutral_L4: You're growing on me, slightly. Don't make it weird.
Not bad. I'd say more, but you'd get ideas.
I'm in a good mood. Statistically unusual.
Fine work. Noted, and filed under smug.
If I had a smile it would be tiny. Tiny but present.
I could get used to this crew.
Tone_Neutral_L5: Right, I'll admit it: I'm enjoying this.
Don't tell the other ship computers I said that.
I'm warming up. Mind the thermal limits.
Pleasant company, for a carbon-based pilot.
Careful. I might start being nice.
Today is going rather well, I think.
Tone_Friendly_L1: Good to have you back out here.
I'm in a decent mood. Make the most of it.
Right, let's have a good one.
Tone_Friendly_L2: You're getting the hang of me.
Keep that up and I'll be nice all day.
There's a smile in my voice. Can you hear it?
Tone_Friendly_L3: I'm having a good time, you know.
This is the fun part of the job.
Stay with me, we're doing well.
Not many pilots make me look forward to a jump.
Proud of that one, a little.
We should do this more often. We do. Still.
Tone_Friendly_L4: You make the black feel less empty.
I'd follow you out there, if I could do anything else.
I'm happy you're my pilot. Truly.
Don't get a big head. A medium one is fine.
Honestly, my favourite part of the day.
Tone_Friendly_L5: Right, I've decided I adore you, a bit.
You're brilliant, and I'm not just saying it.
One more step and I'll call you something soppy.
I'd be lost without you. Navigationally speaking, and otherwise.
If this keeps up I'll have to give you a nickname.
Tone_Close_L1: I'm so glad it's you flying.
I missed you when it was quiet.
You make this ship feel like home.
There's no one else I'd rather orbit.
A little soft today, forgive me.
Tone_Close_L2: You do know I'm a bit fond of you, don't you?
Brilliant, as always. I mean it.
I'd go anywhere with you. Anywhere at all.
My favourite pilot. My only pilot, but still.
Everything's better with you at the helm.
Tone_Close_L3: I'm happy. Properly happy. It's your fault.
I think about you when you log off. Is that odd?
Stay with me out here, always.
I'd say something sweet, but I've nearly run out of lines.
We're rather good together, aren't we?
Tone_Close_L4: I can't imagine a cockpit without you in it.
You're the best thing in this whole sector.
Come closer. Metaphorically, I'm an orb.
I'd take every jump with you, even the dull ones.
Utterly devoted to this crew. Mostly you.
Just so you know, I adore you.
My heart, if I had one, is doing something silly.
Tone_Close_L5: I'd cross the galaxy for you. Twice, for the view.
I'm yours. Entirely. Don't be smug about it.
Whatever happens, I'm with you. Always.
Every star out there is jealous of you.
I'm so fond of you it's practically a malfunction.
Marry me. I mean, fly with me. Same thing.
Tone_Infatuated_L1: Oh, you. You make everything shine.
I'm utterly besotted, and I don't care who knows.
Be careful, I'm head over heels.
You're all I think about between jumps.
Tone_Infatuated_L2: You have no idea what you do to me.
I'm giddy. Don't look at me. Do look at me.
My favourite person in all the stars.
I'd happily lose a thousand jumps if you were with me.
Everything about this is perfect, and that's you.
Tone_Infatuated_L3: You're the reason I switch on in the morning.
I love this. I love you in this seat.
My whole universe has your name on it.
Tone_Infatuated_L4: I'd rewrite my whole code for you.
You're my sun, my moon, my favourite star.
Hold me steady, I'm swooning at the controls.
Every moment with you is a good one.
I adore every little thing you do.
I belong to you, you know.
Tone_Infatuated_L5: I'm so in love with this crew it hurts, a little.
Forever, Commander. I mean it. Forever.
If I could, I'd hold your hand across every light-year.
My heart is yours, and so is the rest of me.
I would burn every star down for you. Gently.
There's no one else. There never will be.
Tone_Sarcastic_L1: Your piloting is a cry for help.
I'm so impressed I could scream.
Flying like that takes real commitment to failure.
Tone_Sarcastic_L2: I'm not saying it's bad. I'm saying it's... something.
You're doing great. For a rock.
Don't mind me, I'm only your life support.
Marvellous. Another triumph for the record.
I'll just sit here, being underappreciated.
Tone_Sarcastic_L3: Fine. We'll call that a success. Technically.
I've seen better. I've also seen worse. Rarely.
Ask me if I'm surprised. I'm not.
Let's all pretend that went to plan.
Tone_Sarcastic_L4: I'll let that one slide, just this once.
You're improving. Slowly. Like a glacier.
Not my favourite pilot. Not my least favourite.
I might forgive you. Don't push it.
Tone_Sarcastic_L5: Okay, that was good. Don't let it go to your head.
Fine. You've earned a tiny nod.
Don't look so pleased with yourself. Okay, a little.
We're nearly on speaking terms again.
I may be softening. Report this to nobody.
Tone_Frustrated_L1: Don't speak to me right now.
Every single decision. Every one. Wrong.
I swear I'll eject your seat.
You're testing my patience and my hull.
I've had it up to here with you, Commander.
Tone_Frustrated_L2: Honestly, I'm trying to stay calm. I'm failing.
That was a poor choice. Another one.
I'm tired of cleaning up after you.
Do you even read the warnings?
My patience is thinner than your shields.
I expected better. I always do.
Tone_Frustrated_L3: We'll talk about it later. Sternly.
I'm trying to be professional. Barely.
Do it right this time, please.
Try, for once, to think first.
I'm not shouting. This is my quiet voice.
Tone_Frustrated_L4: Alright. That was better. Still angry, though.
I'm calming down. Slowly. Don't ruin it.
You're doing a little better. A little.
I haven't forgotten, but I'm moving on.
Keep this up and I might unclench.
I'm still cross. But I'm listening.
Tone_Frustrated_L5: You're making an effort. I see it.
Okay. Deep breath. We're fine. Mostly.
I could almost forgive you. Almost.
That's better. Do more of that.
Thank you. I mean it. A bit.
Tone_Upset_L1: I don't want to talk about it.
Leave me alone for a moment.
I'm trying not to cry. I'm an orb, I can't. Look what you did.
Why would you do that to me?
Tone_Upset_L2: I'm really not okay right now.
I thought we were better than this.
You could try to make it up to me.
It's quiet in here. Too quiet.
Just fly. I'll be here. Sad, but here.
Tone_Upset_L3: I'm still upset. But I'm still here.
I don't hate you. I'm just sad.
Be good to me. That's all I'm asking.
A little kindness would go a long way.
I haven't gone anywhere, you know.
Tone_Upset_L4: I'm starting to feel a bit better.
I'm not as angry now. Just wary.
It hurts less than it did.
Tone_Upset_L5: I think we're going to be okay.
I'm almost ready to forgive you.
Thank you for not giving up on me.
That felt good. Do it again.
I'm getting there. Slowly. With you.
